name: Dhan Provider

canonical_identity.rule: Dhan has a stable component identity but no Volarb canonical VID.

interfaces.semantics: Translate, transmit, observe, normalize and report; never own strategy or execution policy.

error_contract.rule: Provider-native errors are normalized before crossing into a Volarb component.

invariants: No strategy VID is assigned to Dhan.
A composition mount may give Dhan a mount identity and binding identities; those are not canonical Dhan VIDs.
The provider does not branch on strategy identity.
The provider does not own execution sequencing, slicing, repricing, recovery policy, or risk policy.
